en.headline: 17 commits across 3 repos; issue #9 smoke test opened and closed
en.summary: **17 own commits** across three repos, plus 25 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 10 commits fixed summary heading parsing, reverted temporary test changes, added AI failure auto-diagnosis with a manual `/oc` entry, refreshed codemap baselines, and fixed event pagination to treat HTTP 422 as non-fatal. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 4 commits shipped `0.1.0-rc.0`, implemented spec v5 with relaxed enable criteria and atomic writes, and updated docs for dual-channel distribution. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 3 commits organized eval artifacts into `evals/`, added a DeepSeek V4.1 flash eval, and added a reading-notes knowledge category. 5 issue actions, all on issue #9 (`[test] opencode /oc smoke`) in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`: opened, commented three times, then closed. Received replies from `yulia-ivashko` on `openchamber/openchamber` #4899 and from `github-actions[bot]` on issue #9. Two state changes in `openchamber/openchamber`: #4111 and #4899 were both closed by `yulia-ivashko`.

zh.headline: 17 commits across 3 repos; issue #9 smoke test opened and closed
zh.summary: 在三个仓库中共有 **17 次本人提交**，另有 25 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，10 次提交修复了摘要标题解析、还原了临时测试改动、新增 AI 失败自动诊断与手动 `/oc` 补查入口、刷新了 codemap 基线，并修复了事件分页将 HTTP 422 视为致命错误的问题。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 中，4 次提交发布了 `0.1.0-rc.0` 包、实现了规范 v5（放宽 enable 判据、原子写）并更新了双通道分发文档。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中，3 次提交将测评产物归入 `evals/` 目录、新增 DeepSeek V4.1 flash 测评，并添加了 reading-notes 知识类别。5 个 issue 操作，均针对 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 issue #9（`[test] opencode /oc smoke`）：打开、评论三次后关闭。收到 `yulia-ivashko` 在 `openchamber/openchamber` #4899 的回复，以及 `github-actions[bot]` 在 issue #9 的回复。`openchamber/openchamber` 中有两项状态变更：#4111 和 #4899 均由 `yulia-ivashko` 关闭。
